_comment: Fitness function (docs/delivery.md, quality gates): the wasm-opt'ed module may not exceed its last measured size plus 25%. Spike S1 measured 437,223 B on 2026-11-04 (budget 546,529). PR 3 measured 1,353,901 B on 2026-11-05 (439,521 B before it): sign-in's argon2id, RS256 on rsa and HMAC-SHA256, the three objects and the new routes, plus about 39 KB for the seed generator. PR 4 measured 2,316,525 B on 2026-11-05 (1,353,901 B before it): the Catalog, Order and Kitchen objects with the domain's menu, order and board rules, the Sandbox's seeding of 14 children, the outbox relay, the Queue consumer and DLQ writer, and the menu, order, dead-letter and clock routes; reading object bodies with serde_json alone instead of serde-wasm-bindgen kept 136,666 B of it out. PR 5 measured 3,013,075 B on 2026-11-05 (2,316,525 B at PR 4; PR 5's domain stream could not be built alone, since the API did not compile until the Worker stream's changes): the Billing aggregate and its ledger, Stripe's wire types, the form encoder, the webhook signature check and the request builders in bakery-app, and in the Worker the Billing object, the Stripe adapter over fetch, the payment, refund, ledger and webhook routes, the Order's event and refund paths, and the Simulator's payments. The platform's limit is 64 MiB; this is a budget. Raise it only with a line saying what the bytes buy. PR 6 measured 3,591,024 B on 2026-11-05 (3,013,075 B at PR 5): the domain's calendar, clock steps and Schedule aggregate with its production plan, and in the Worker the Schedule object with its hold timers, the hold at placement and its release, the schedule and capacity routes, the clock's steps, the consumer's day resolution, the Sandbox's seven seeded days, the Kitchen's bake lists and the loop guard's pure planner. PR 7 measured 4,113,149 B on 2026-11-05 (3,591,024 B at PR 6): the domain's catering aggregate with its timers, free-text brief check and calendar helpers, Billing's invoices and Stripe Invoicing's request builders and readers, and in the Worker the CateringEvent object with its saga timers, seed replay and late-deposit refund, the twelve catering routes and their problems, Billing's balance invoice, deposit refund, test-path payment and Stripe cleanup at the wipe, the Schedule's catering edges, the consumer's catering day resolution, and the Sandbox's catering registration and seeding of 8 events and 3 days. PR 8 measured 5,031,202 B on 2026-11-05 (4,113,149 B at PR 7): the domain's Customer, Crm projection with its segments, templates, campaign aggregate and rebuild, and the Inbox with its message templates and seeded engagement draw, the seed's history envelopes, 240 messages and directory, and in the Worker the Customer, Crm and Inbox objects (the campaign send timer, the rebuild's batched alarm, the engagement timers), the eighteen CRM, campaign, inbox and rebuild routes and their problems, the consumer's customer resolution, and the Sandbox's seeding of Crm and the Inbox and its persona table. Stripped on 2026-11-05: `strip = "symbols"` in the release profile drops rustc's wasm name section, which was 24% of the module and nothing at run time (a trap then shows wasm-function[N] frames; exports and imports keep their names), so the same code measured 3,812,321 B at PR 8 against 5,031,202 B with names, and the budget is reset to 4,765,401 B, that plus 25%. The step down is names, not code: read the earlier numbers with that in mind. PR 9 measured 4,202,873 B stripped on 2026-11-05 (3,812,321 B at PR 8 stripped; 5,531,012 B with the name section, against PR 8's 5,031,202 B with it): the domain's Dispatch aggregate with its validator, the Clarke-Wright savings heuristic and the travel-time matrix reader, the Salt Lake City matrix fixture compiled in (19,071 B of JSON), the dispatch view, and in the Worker the Dispatch object, the five dispatch routes and their problems, the consumer's stop edges (the Dispatch day, the persona's place, the published plan to each stop's Order and the Kitchen's van labels), the Order's out-for-delivery and delivered edges, and the Sandbox's dispatch registration and seeded day.
